outcome: Drug usage in neonatal intensive care unit
Indications for neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 98 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary care hospital in Bangalore, India
finding: Premature birth and resulting low birth weight were the main reasons for drug prescription in this neonatal intensive care unit.
mod_finding: 80.6% of the neonates were born by cesarean section and 19.4% were born by normal vaginal delivery.
